name: description-list
title: Description List
description: Terms and their details, such as the fields of an order, a profile or a file: a `dl` on web.

examples.name: basic
examples.title: Basic
examples.code:
import { Badge, DescriptionList } from '@advui/core'

export default function DescriptionListBasic() {
  return (
    <DescriptionList width="100%" maxWidth="112">
      <DescriptionList.Item term="Order">#4021</DescriptionList.Item>
      <DescriptionList.Item term="Placed">October 14, 2026</DescriptionList.Item>
      <DescriptionList.Item term="Status">
        <Badge variant="success">Paid</Badge>
      </DescriptionList.Item>
      <DescriptionList.Item term="Ship to">
        Ada Lovelace, 12 Garden Lane, Bristol BS1 4DJ
      </DescriptionList.Item>
    </DescriptionList>
  )
}

examples.name: divided
examples.title: Vertical, with lines
examples.code:
import { DescriptionList, Link } from '@advui/core'

export default function DescriptionListDivided() {
  return (
    <DescriptionList orientation="vertical" divided width="100%" maxWidth="96">
      <DescriptionList.Item term="Full name">Ada Lovelace</DescriptionList.Item>
      <DescriptionList.Item term="Email">
        <Link href="mailto:ada@example.com" size="sm">
          ada@example.com
        </Link>
      </DescriptionList.Item>
      <DescriptionList.Item term="Role">Admin</DescriptionList.Item>
      <DescriptionList.Item term="About">
        Writes the release notes and looks after the design system, and knows the build best.
      </DescriptionList.Item>
    </DescriptionList>
  )
}
